paragraphs.text: The proposer offers a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup, as specified in the RFP. This configuration meets the requirement for a 15 kV two-section metal-clad switchgear lineup, ensuring compliance with the customer's specifications.

The proposed switchgear lineup includes 18 vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs). This configuration aligns with the detailed requirements outlined in the RFP.
